chapter: Small's Paradise, Fletcher Henderson and Horace
title: Wilberforce, Jimmy Rushing and Caldwell's father
summary: Caldwell was at Wilberforce years before Horace Henderson and Rushing, left before graduating, and says his father worked for an elevator company.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You'd been to Wilberforce before Horace.
Yeah, I mean almost six, seven years.
Yeah, Jimmy Rushing used to go there too.
I didn't know he did. What's he -- what did he learn to play there?

Jimmy learned -- Jimmy played a little piano, you know, and singing too. Of course, that was big thing then on the candles, had those little school parties and shows and things. We were really big. We didn't have much of a band, but we had -- kids could play.
Was he there when you were there?
No, Jimmy was there -- I was there before Jimmy, but I didn't stay there and graduate. I came back to Chicago when Jimmy went there.
Jimmy's parents were fairly well off, weren't they?
Yeah. What did your father do?
My father worked he had a saloon school one time, and then they -- he worked for the elevator company in Chicago for years.
Well, you know, he had to bring that's pulling up a pretty big family, didn't he?
Oh, yeah, he had up to seven. Of course, my oldest brother was working, my oldest sister.
That's interesting because he doesn't Rushing have this about Jimmy Russian going to Wilberforce.
